name: Fluid Image Grid
description: WebGL image grid where each photo ripples like liquid on hover and opens in a lightbox on click. Switches from multiple columns to a single column on narrow screens.
contents: Grid of image planes rendered in a full-height canvas
Thin inset frame with an accent line and a hint caption
behavior: Images continuously drift with a subtle liquid motion
Hovering an image raises a wave distortion that eases back on leave
Clicking an image opens it in a Fancybox lightbox
Layout switches between desktop and mobile column counts below 600px container width and re-lays out on resize

props.name: hintText
props.default: [ Hover to distort / Click to expand ]

editableByProps: Images, column counts, spacing and plane sizes
Wave strength, liquid speed and easing
Accent and background colors, hint caption

needsCodeEdit.where: vertexShader and fragmentShader strings in initWebGL

fixed: Root is a full-viewport-height section with the canvas centered
Planes are square and the grid must fit the camera view, so many images need larger spacing or smaller plane sizes
Opening the lightbox loads Fancybox styles through a CSS import
